core_obligations: Sufficiency: if there is a locally quasi-finite cover of the source over every test object with locally quasi-finite composite, then applying the local quasi-finiteness characterization to the composite shows that the morphism is locally quasi-finite and hence quasi-DM (proof lines 5103-5112)

Necessity: if the morphism is locally quasi-finite, the covers of the characterization over each test object have locally quasi-finite structure over the test object, which is exactly the stated condition (proof lines 5113-5131)
proof_roadmap: 充分性：所给覆盖满足局部拟有限的刻画条件 ⇒ 态射局部拟有限 ⇒ 准 DM。
必要性：局部拟有限时，对每个测试对象取刻画里的覆盖，其到测试对象的复合仍局部拟有限。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is quasi-DM exactly when over every test algebraic space there is a locally quasi-finite cover of the source whose composite to the test object is locally quasi-finite (author lemma at source lines 5085-5101, label lemma-characterize-quasi-DM). The proof (source lines 5103-5132) applies the local quasi-finiteness characterization in both directions, using the covering criterion in between (proof lines 5103-5131). The two applications of the characterization are the substance. H3.
